applicabilityBasis.summary: USBD is described as a decentralized dollar-targeted stablecoin minted by users against collateral through autonomous smart contracts. Bima Protocol Limited disclaims peg guarantees and protocol control. The opened documents do not establish an issuer obligation to redeem for national currency or a deposit, leaving applicability unclear.

references.label: GENIUS Act Public Law 119-27, payment stablecoin definition

genius.notes: BIMA PROTOCOL LIMITED is the contractual interface operator; its privacy policy identifies a BVI entity. Those documents do not establish that it is the legal issuer or monetary-value redemption obligor of USBD. issuerEntity and issuerDomicile are omitted. The current homepage primarily markets structured Bitcoin finance while live terms and privacy disclosures still describe USBD. No qualifying GENIUS intent or monthly independent reserve attestation was identified in the consulted disclosures. The pre-effective DASP enum describes only GENIUS timing, not permission under other laws.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, independently reopened token disclosures, federal proposal pages, the NYDFS directory and targeted token/operator searches did not identify a public qualifying GENIUS approval, state qualification, token-specific application or foreign registration for Bima USBD. The exact legal token issuer remains unresolved. This public-source negative finding does not establish absence of unpublished filings or filings under an unidentified legal name.
